scope: Actual fresh installed aerials physically viewed as three prepublication vs-reference JPGs; all30 P0 differences re-scored. Publication may later copy the same native images.

differences.difference: Dark mow bands dominate every grass pad.
differences.evidence: Root physical view of fresh p7_installed_round1 native aerial beside reference; round2 prepublication JPG SHA retained.
differences.remaining: Broad patchy bands remain visible; numeric contrast passing does not make this nearly uniform reference grass.

differences.difference: Long separated low slabs lack the reference island mass and overhangs.
differences.evidence: Root physical view of fresh p7_installed_round1 native aerial beside reference; round2 prepublication JPG SHA retained.
differences.remaining: Three separated low grass pads still lack the deep irregular layered reference island mass; tee pad is cropped in this aerial.

differences.evidence: Root physical view of fresh p7_installed_round1 native aerial beside reference; round2 prepublication JPG SHA retained.
differences.remaining: Cliff sides still look like repeated shallow horizontal courses; actual outline runs4.936–5.354m exceed4m.

differences.evidence: Root physical view of fresh p7_installed_round1 native aerial beside reference; round2 prepublication JPG SHA retained.
